title: Do We Really Use Only 10% of Our Brain?

scenes.text: Your brain uses only 10% of its capacity?
Many believe we only use ten percent of our brain.
scenes.label: We only use 10% of our brain

scenes.text: Neuroimaging shows the brain lights up across almost every region even at rest, meaning we use nearly 100% of it over a day.
scenes.label: Brain uses nearly 100% daily
scenes.query: brain MRI activity full brain usage

scenes.text: Your brain is always active, even when you’re sleeping.
scenes.label: Always Active
scenes.sub: Brain shows activity even at rest

scenes.text: Follow if you love learning something new.

description: The 10% brain myth persists, but science proves our minds are far more active than that. Discover the real truth and keep your curiosity sharp.
